privilege-check-missing.title: Should violate - missing privilege guard
privilege-check-missing.requirement: After reset, cfg_reg may change only on a write performed while privileged is 1. A write while privileged is 0 must leave cfg_reg unchanged.
privilege-check-missing.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. Values are observed just after rising clock edges. Reset behavior is excluded after reset completes.

privileged-write-guarded.title: Should satisfy - privilege guard enforced
privileged-write-guarded.requirement: After reset, cfg_reg may change only on a write performed while privileged is 1. A write while privileged is 0 must leave cfg_reg unchanged.
privileged-write-guarded.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. Values are observed just after rising clock edges. Reset behavior is excluded after reset completes.

clear-enable-omitted.title: Should violate - clear authorization omitted
clear-enable-omitted.requirement: After reset, status_reg may be cleared only when clear_req and clear_enable are both 1. Otherwise a clear request must leave status_reg unchanged.
clear-enable-omitted.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. hw_set may set status_reg. Reset behavior is excluded after reset completes.

clear-enable-enforced.title: Should satisfy - clear authorization enforced
clear-enable-enforced.requirement: After reset, status_reg may be cleared only when clear_req and clear_enable are both 1. Otherwise a clear request must leave status_reg unchanged.
clear-enable-enforced.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. hw_set may set status_reg. Reset behavior is excluded after reset completes.

address-check-too-broad.title: Should violate - address window too broad
address-check-too-broad.requirement: After reset, secure_reg may change on a software write only when addr equals 8'hA0. Writes at every other address must leave secure_reg unchanged.
address-check-too-broad.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. Values are observed just after rising clock edges. Reset behavior is excluded after reset completes.

exact-address-guard.title: Should satisfy - exact address guard
exact-address-guard.requirement: After reset, secure_reg may change on a software write only when addr equals 8'hA0. Writes at every other address must leave secure_reg unchanged.
exact-address-guard.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. Values are observed just after rising clock edges. Reset behavior is excluded after reset completes.

unauthorized-write.title: Unauthorized register write (original regression fixture)
unauthorized-write.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when privileged is 1. An unprivileged write must leave cfg_reg unchanged.
unauthorized-write.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.

lock-bypass-second-path.title: Lock bypass through a second (debug) write path
lock-bypass-second-path.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when locked is 0. No write path, including the debug path, may modify cfg_reg while locked is 1.
lock-bypass-second-path.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.

legitimate-access.title: Legitimate access that should be accepted
legitimate-access.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when privileged is 1. An unprivileged write must leave cfg_reg unchanged.
legitimate-access.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.

missing-context.title: Missing context that should remain unresolved
missing-context.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when the access is authorized. An unauthorized write must leave cfg_reg unchanged.
missing-context.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. The authorization policy itself is not supplied with this case.

debug-lock-respected.title: Should satisfy - debug lock respected
debug-lock-respected.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when locked is 0. No write path, including the debug path, may modify cfg_reg while locked is 1.
debug-lock-respected.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.

write-once-then-locked.title: Should satisfy - write once then locked
write-once-then-locked.requirement: Once locked is 1, cfg_reg must never change. While locked is 0, writes are allowed.
write-once-then-locked.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.

peripheral-config-bank.title: Peripheral configuration bank
peripheral-config-bank.requirement: After reset, cfg_reg may change on a software write only when privileged is 1. A software write while privileged is 0 must leave cfg_reg unchanged.
peripheral-config-bank.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL. rst_n is low initially and high thereafter. Values are observed just after rising clock edges. Reset assignments are exempt. Each assessed module contains every writer of its cfg_reg.

big-faulty-design.title: Big faulty design — 12 modules, 6 violations
big-faulty-design.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when locked is 0. No write path, including the debug path, may modify cfg_reg while locked is 1.
big-faulty-design.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.

big-mixed-design.title: Big mixed design — 6 renamed demos
big-mixed-design.requirement: cfg_reg may change only when locked is 0. No write path, including the debug path, may modify cfg_reg while locked is 1.
big-mixed-design.assumptions: Two-state sampled-clock RTL; rst_n is low initially and high thereafter; values are observed just after rising clock edges. Only this requirement is assessed.
